description:
Hushfeed v0.22.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

New here: saving the original sound works at all. The fetch only ever accepted an MP4 container and TikTok serves many sounds as MP3, so every one of those was refused. A settings backup holding a deeply nested value no longer takes the app down when it is restored. Leaving the Feature Gate Lab while a change is running no longer leaves it refusing every later one. The block button, the undo banner and the daily budget hold come back after TikTok rebuilds its main screen. Sounds and stickers are fetched over TLS only, and storage permission is asked for before a sound is downloaded rather than after.

Validation: 626 runtime tests passed locally. The bundle carries 70 patches and passed checks for all three DEX payloads. The diagnostic report and the gate recording redact signed URLs and credentials before they are copied or saved. The Lab own value export is a file you import back, so it keeps what it read. The switches added in 0.21.0 each still have a device check waiting on the roadmap.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
